description: This file defines a Swift struct 'OpenClawDateRangeLimitParams' that models date range limit parameters with optional start and end ISO date strings and an optional limit count. It conforms to Codable, Sendable, and Equatable, enabling serialization, concurrency-safe sharing, and comparison.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of 'OpenClawDateRangeLimitParams' with optional startISO, endISO, and limit values.
